authors.name: Eiichiro Oda
authors.bio: Eiichiro Oda is a Japanese manga artist best known for creating 'One Piece', one of the best-selling comic series of all time. His work is celebrated for its expansive world-building, memorable characters, and adventurous storytelling.

authors.name: Masashi Kishimoto
authors.bio: Masashi Kishimoto is a Japanese manga creator famous for the immensely popular 'Naruto' series. His stories combine action, friendship, and personal growth in a detailed ninja world.

authors.name: Stan Lee
authors.bio: Stan Lee was an American comic book writer, editor, and publisher who helped create many of Marvel Comics' most iconic superheroes. His influence shaped modern superhero comics and popular culture.

authors.name: Robert Kirkman
authors.bio: Robert Kirkman is an American comic book writer best known for creating 'The Walking Dead' and 'Invincible'. His work often explores survival, morality, and complex character relationships.

authors.name: Alan Moore
authors.bio: Alan Moore is a British comic book writer widely regarded as one of the greatest authors in the medium. His works have had a profound impact on modern comics through mature themes and innovative storytelling.
